hydro.info.racks.title: SOILLESS FARMING · HYDROPONICS
hydro.info.racks.1: The roots are not in soil: they grow in rock-wool cubes bathed by a thin film of recirculating water with nutrients. The technique is called NFT.
hydro.info.racks.2: Good water range in the game: {dry}–{flood} %. With too little water the plant wilts; with too much, the roots run out of oxygen and rot.
hydro.info.racks.3: Lights: red (≈660 nm) and blue (≈450 nm) LEDs are the colours chlorophyll absorbs best; that is why the light looks pink. Here they are on from {start}:00 to {end}:00.
hydro.info.racks.4: Photosynthesis: 6 CO₂ + 6 H₂O + light → C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6 O₂. Each healthy lit channel removes ≈{co2} ppm of CO₂ per hour and adds O₂ to the base.
hydro.info.racks.5: On the Space Station, NASA's Veggie experiment grew red romaine lettuce that the crew ate in 2015.
hydro.info.tank.title: NUTRIENT SOLUTION
hydro.info.tank.1: Without soil, the plant takes its minerals from the water: mostly nitrogen (N), phosphorus (P) and potassium (K), plus a little calcium, magnesium, iron and others.
hydro.info.tank.2: Two readings are watched: the pH (5.5–6.5, so the minerals stay available) and the electrical conductivity, which tells how much salt is dissolved (≈ 1–3 mS/cm).
hydro.info.tank.3: In the game: level {level} %. Below {low} % the plants grow at half speed, but they do not die. Each cartridge raises the level by {step} points. {count} left.
hydro.info.tank.4: The water recirculates: what the plants breathe out condenses and returns to the tank ({condensate} % in the game).
hydro.info.bio.title: SPIRULINA BIOREACTOR
hydro.info.bio.1: Crop progress: {pct} %. It only grows with light ({hours} h of light per harvest, +{kcal} kcal).
hydro.info.pantry.title: KEEPING THE HARVEST
hydro.info.pantry.1: After harvest, vegetables keep breathing and lose water and sugars; microbes also grow. Unprocessed, they last {hours} h in the game.
hydro.info.kitchen.title: FOOD PROCESSING
hydro.info.kitchen.1: Drying removes the water microbes need to grow: the food weighs less and lasts much longer. Much of space food is dehydrated or thermostabilized.
hydro.info.kitchen.2: Ingredients: protein (soybean, quinoa, spirulina), carbs (carrot, sweet potato) and fresh (lettuce, tomato). The button picks the recipe that gives the most kcal.
hydro.info.kitchen.3: The multiplier is a game simplification: processing does not create energy; it stands for using and keeping the food better.
